descricao_produto: PRODUCT: a set of exactly three identical tall slim cylindrical body splash spray bottles standing upright side by side in one straight row, close together and evenly spaced, all facing the camera with labels fully visible, always in this fixed order from left to right: ENIGMA (black label), MIDTOWN (brushed silver label), BARBARIUS (deep navy blue label).
